source_title: India Today HealthWealth Summit starts today: 2 days of expert insights and more - India Today
source_excerpt:
Union Health Minister JP Nadda will inaugurate the two-day HealthWealth Summit in Noida. The event marks the platform's first large public gathering, taking its coverage beyond digital space.
HealthWealth, India Today’s new multimedia platform on health and well-being, will hold the first edition of the HealthWealth Summit on October 29 and 30. Union Health and Family Welfare Minister JP Nadda will inaugurate the two-day event.
This is the first health carnival of its kind in the country. The idea is to move health out of studio discussions and give visitors something they can experience directly, through expert advice, hands-on fitness sessions and specialist guidance.
The carnival is built around three parts.
Doctors’ sessions: Some of India’s leading doctors will take up the health questions that people ask most often. The focus is on practical answers to everyday concerns from the experts who treat these conditions.
Fitness Arena: Live demonstrations will test popular fitness claims against evidence. Visitors can see what actually works, and which widely repeated advice does not hold up.
Wellness Hub: Specialists will be on hand to help visitors make informed choices about their health and well-being.
HealthWealth “What Money Can’t Buy”, has been launched as a dedicated space for health reporting and wellness content across formats. The carnival is its first large public event, and it takes the platform’s work from screens to a physical venue.
The event will also reach a much larger audience beyond those who attend. The programme will be showcased prominently to Aaj Tak’s more than 200 million television viewers, and will be backed by the network’s digital presence across X, Facebook, YouTube, WAP, AP and the web.
The event is happening at Mediaplex 2, FC-7, Film City, Noida.
